name: Non-Linear Sphere Tracing
aliases: Non-linear sphere tracing for deformed SDFs
definition: A variant of sphere tracing that accounts for a non-linear deformation of space. It uses the Runge-Kutta method to step along the ray in the deformed space and transforms the surface normal using the Jacobian of the deformation at the hit point.
summary: Non-Linear Sphere Tracing renders deformed signed distance fields by numerically integrating ray trajectories, distinguishing itself by modeling deformation Jacobians instead of relying on static Euclidean metrics.
